experiments.title: Validate Reservation-Constrained Accounting Theory
experiments.objective: Collect sufficient independent evidence to determine whether "Reservation-Constrained Accounting Theory" should be validated or rejected.
experiments.hypothesis: "Reservation-Constrained Accounting Theory" predicts that independent executable evidence will reproduce the scientific relation "RESERVATION:CONSTRAINS:ACCOUNTING".
experiments.supportCondition: Reservation-Constrained Accounting Theory is supported when an executable assertion demonstrates behavior consistent with the scientific relation "RESERVATION:CONSTRAINS:ACCOUNTING".
experiments.challengeCondition: Reservation-Constrained Accounting Theory is challenged when an executable assertion reproduces a counterexample incompatible with the scientific relation "RESERVATION:CONSTRAINS:ACCOUNTING".

support.condition: Reservation-Constrained Accounting Theory is supported when an executable assertion demonstrates behavior consistent with the scientific relation "RESERVATION:CONSTRAINS:ACCOUNTING".

challenge.condition: Reservation-Constrained Accounting Theory is challenged when an executable assertion reproduces a counterexample incompatible with the scientific relation "RESERVATION:CONSTRAINS:ACCOUNTING".
